defects.description: Multiple headers were left untranslated in English.
Mistranslation of passive voice ('is asked') to active voice ('просит'), which incorrectly suggests the operator is the one making the request rather than receiving it.
The glossary term 'Объект обсуждения' (Subject) was used where the English word 'subject' is a predicate ('subject to a vote') and not the noun defined in the glossary.
